About Me

Building for the web.
Driven by data.

I am a 3rd-year Computer Science undergraduate at Bicol University Polangui, working toward a career in full-stack development. I am deeply interested in how data can drive decisions, and I enjoy creating clean, functional interfaces that make information accessible and meaningful.

My academic work spans database design, Android development, and UI/UX prototyping. I am actively building on these foundations through self-study, online certifications, and personal projects.

I am looking for opportunities where I can contribute to real products, work alongside experienced developers, and grow both technically and professionally.
